items: New mode: Survival, a third button on the title screen. Every team has 2 or 3 lives and loses one for each wrong answer, and the last team standing wins.
Eight rounds climb from 100s to 500s, with a new category each round. Play turn by turn or all at once. Cairo cinema poster look.

Most Spotify Listeners and Most Instagram Followers are now ordering rounds: drag the three names into order, most first. The reveal shows everyone's figure, and names within 1M of each other count either way round.
Category Bingo: Most Spotify Listeners and Most Instagram Followers can now land on the board.
Bidding Wars: a new Raise amounts switch in setup. Teams choose (+$50/+$100/+$200 buttons) or +$50 only.
Category Bingo: Act It Out and One Word Clues are off the board. Closest Wins and Price Is Right are on it: every team guesses and the closest team takes the square.
Category Bingo: the default board is now 49 random categories from everything available, instead of 7 from each section.
Category Bingo: a new Win with switch in setup. Play to 5 in a row as before, or to 6 in a row for a longer game.
Category Bingo: much bigger squares on TVs and laptops. The teams, turn line and buttons move to a column on the left, and the board fills the rest of the screen.
Bidding Wars: every team's score now also shows at the top centre of the auction screen.
Bidding Wars: each team now picks how much it raises by (+$50, +$100 or +$200) with the chips on its card. A raise past the lot's max stops at the max.
Category Bingo: a new Photo rounds switch in setup. Turn it off and no photo categories (Guess the Car, Actor, Footballer, Person, Food, Logo, Country, Egypt: Photo Edition) show up on the board.

Category Bingo and Bidding Wars games can't be resumed any more: the Resume Bingo and Resume Bidding buttons are gone, and leaving one of those games mid-way now asks you to confirm first. Normal, Football and Wager games still resume after a refresh.

New game mode: Bidding Wars, a button at the bottom of the title screen. Teams bid on lots that show only a title, the categories it includes and a difficulty range; the highest bidder answers and wins or loses exactly what they bid.
Entry $200–$300 (max bid $600), Medium $300–$400 ($1,200) and Expert $400–$500 ($1,500). Bidding opens at the bottom of the range and goes up $50 a time. 10 to 15 lots, each a random tier.

A trading floor look of its own: black screen, amber numbers, green bid buttons and a ticker of the scores. In setup: the sold timer (3 to 20 seconds, or off), photo rounds on or off, and which titles come up.

New game mode: Category Bingo, a button at the bottom of the title screen. A 7x7 board of 49 categories: teams take turns claiming squares by answering, and the first to get 5 in a row wins. Each team has 1 or 2 steals to take an opponent's square.
Three board looks to choose from (Classic, Bingo card, Neon), and you can flip between them with the Look button while you play. Squares show the category name; harder squares sit in the middle.
Faint letters (A to G) along the top and numbers (1 to 7) down the left of the Bingo board, so squares can be called out like "C4".
About 2,900 new clues: 30 more in almost every non-photo category, with the new 200s and 300s pitched harder than before.
Street scenes combined: the man chasing the bus misses it and hails a microbus instead, the hantour gets stuck behind the Eid sheep, and the bread woman stops for the wedding convoy with a zaghrouta.
The street now has 7 scenes instead of 10.
New in setup: Wager mode. The team that picks a tile bets 0 to double its value before seeing the clue. Right adds the bet, wrong takes it away, and scores can go below zero.
On Closest Wins and Price Is Right every team bets: the closest wins its bet and the rest lose theirs.
When it isn't your team's turn, the only score button you get is half points (a steal). Free-for-all, Password, Closest Wins and Impostor are unchanged.
On mirrored rounds the street sweeper and his traffic light are on the far side of the car from the start, so the car drives past in front of him.
The street sweeper always begs at the driver's window. On mirrored rounds he walks round the front of the car to the far side.
Seven new categories: Tennis, Oldies, Facts, Holidays & Traditions, Animal Kingdom (with photos), Cocktails & Drinks and Landmarks (with photos).
What's the Link? is harder, Riddles are all new and more creative, and Put It in Order has 50 more clues.
The street scene keeps playing, faintly, behind an open clue. Flags load with the board, so they show up straight away.
The sweeper sweeps more naturally and begs at the driver's window. The last sheep stops twice and gets a tap each time.
Football mode: each board opens with a sole roll and flick-up volley, and there's a new touch where the ball bounces off a planted foot.
Mix clues show their real category in gold, and a mix you've edited gets a ✎ on its chip.
Edit mixes now sits above Teams, with each mix folded until you open it. Hovering a mix lists its categories as bullets.
New Everything Mix: every category except Act It Out and One Word Clues. Guess the … Mix is now Guess the ____ Mix.
Emoji Movies & TV moved to Entertainment, after Pixar. The Parent Trap is hidden for now.
The locked category's description just says "Code required" until the code is entered.
TV Show Mix is a real mix now: choose which shows it uses in Edit mixes (Netflix Hits can be added too).
TV Show Mix is now in the Mixes group, after Entertainment Mix 2.
The category count on the title screen no longer counts the mixes.
On smaller screens the ful customer no longer waits around: he reaches his spot just as the cart arrives.
On smaller screens the street sweeper works a little further in, so he no longer sweeps on top of the bawab.
The street sweeper reaches up and takes the note from the driver's hand at the window.
The bus door is always on the bus's right side: going the other way, the man runs up behind it and boards out of sight.
The street sweeper pleads at the car window before he gets the money.
When the dog bolts, the lead snaps taut and drags the woman forward before it rips out of her hand.
The bawab now sets his chair down facing you, the way he sits in it, steps aside, then backs into it.
Edit mixes: in Free-for-all, Act It Out and One Word Clues are greyed out (they need teams).
Edit mixes: Party Games Mix can now include Act It Out, Act It Out: Egypt Edition and One Word Clues.
New Edit mixes panel at the bottom of setup: choose which categories each mix uses, from its own section. Saved on this device, with a Reset per mix.
Guess the… Mix is now written "Guess the … Mix".
The mixes on the setup screen are in the same order as the sections below them.
The Parent Trap: 24 new "Hallie or Annie? Which twin really says this?" clues, getting harder at higher values.
Mix clues show which category they came from again, e.g. "Party Games Mix · Price Is Right".
The Parent Trap is now about the film itself: more plot questions and "Who says it?" lines instead of budget and filming trivia.
Mix clues no longer say which category they came from, just the mix and the value.
Guess the… Mix is now the photo rounds only.

New Mixes group: ten bigger categories that pull clues from several others (Egypt Mix 1 and 2, Guess the… Mix, Maps & World Mix, Party Games Mix, Knowledge Mix 1 and 2, Entertainment Mix 1 and 2, and Football Mix). Each clue shows which category it came from.
New category: The Parent Trap (the 1998 film), 75 hard clues.
Every flag in Guess the Flag is redrawn accurately, with the real coats of arms and emblems (Spain, Serbia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia and more). Flags now show in a 4:3 shape.
Football mode: the photo collage behind the board is fainter (50%, was 80%).
No more pothole: the tuk-tuk just drives straight past the ful cart.
The ful cart and the tuk-tuk are one street scene now: the tuk-tuk honks past while the ful man is serving.
On shisha visits the bawab now bends down and sets the shisha in its place before he puts his chair down.
The bawab now sets his chair down first, stands a moment, and then sits, instead of doing it all in one go. His friend does the same.
When the family motorbike passes the woman walking her dog, the dog bolts after it. The lead slips out of her hand and trails behind him, and she drops her call and runs after him.
The street sweeper now stops a couple of steps back from the car and bends down with both hands out to the window to take the money.
The wedding escort bike no longer weaves. It pulls three wheelies across the screen instead, the middle one the longest.
The sweeper's traffic light is twice as big and looks like a real one, with a yellow backboard and three hooded lamps.
The man chasing the bus lowers his hand before he jumps on, then holds the door at chest height.
The family motorbike comes in a bit later behind the woman walking her dog.
In the cat scene the ginger cat sets off running first, then the grey cat bolts.

Most Instagram Followers and Most Spotify Listeners: at the higher values all three names are now close, not just the top two. Instagram also has more people, like Priyanka Chopra, Jennie and Snoop Dogg.
The street sweeper flips his traffic light to green before the BMW drives off.
30 more Price Is Right clues, all Egyptian: museum and pyramid tickets, ful and ta'meya, ahwa tea, kahk, Eid sheep, the monorail and LRT, iPhone prices in Egypt and more.
The street sweeper now sets down a traffic light on red. The BMW stops at it, he asks at the window, gets his money, then packs up the light and broom and leaves.
The family motorbike now rides past the woman walking her dog, her lead hand stays still, the wedding escort bike weaves, and the bus rider holds on calmly.

760 new clues: 25 more in every Football mode text category, 30 more in Price Is Right, Put It in Order, General Knowledge, Egypt and Arab World, and 100 country-fact clues in each Which Country? category.
Most Spotify Listeners and Most Instagram Followers have 30 more clues each and are harder, with closer races at every value.
Fixed the descriptions for Which Country?, Which Country? Arab Edition and Guess the Song: the city or lyric is on screen, the host doesn't read it out.
Hover over a category in setup or on the board to see a short, easy description in a big box you can read from the couch.
The join screen shows just the code, without the link under it.
On shisha visits the bawab brings a friend in a brown galabeya with his own chair. He sits beside him smoking a cigarette and leaves with him when the shisha's done.
The bawab drags his plastic chair behind him by the top of its backrest when he comes and goes.
The bus's open door is at the front, like Egyptian buses, so the man runs up alongside it and jumps on there.
The street sweeper starts sweeping sooner, and the BMW only drives in once he has started.
The bawab takes a shisha pull every 12 seconds and a cigarette drag every 10, breathing out a bit more smoke.
The bawab takes a shisha pull every 10 seconds and a cigarette drag every 7, instead of every 5.
The bawab has three visits in turn: dozing, smoking a shisha (a pull every 5 seconds and a big cloud), and smoking a cigarette that he flicks away when it's done before he leaves.
The Eid sheep move as a loose flock ahead of the shepherd, and he only reaches them with his stick when the last one stops to graze.
The bus gets further before the man catches it, and the street sweeper just sweeps, with no leaves or wind.
The wedding car no longer has an arm waving out of the back window.
The bawab now sits facing you, slumped back in his chair, and a few seconds after sitting down his head tips over as he dozes off.

The Eid sheep aren't tied any more: the man walks behind them with a stick, and taps on one that stops to graze. Plus a darker hantour horse, a steadier wedding flare, and the sweeper carries his broom and sweeps nearer the side he comes from.
The wedding motorbike honks too, taking turns with the car.
The wedding car is now led by a motorbike, its passenger waving a flare to celebrate the couple.
The street sweeper now pockets the BMW driver's tip and walks off.
Cat scene: a grey cat wanders in from the other side, bolts when the ginger cat spots her, and gets chased off.

Six new street scenes: a family of four on a motorbike, a woman carrying bread on her head as a delivery bike passes, a wedding car, a man chasing a bus, a man leading five sheep for Eid, and a street sweeper who gets a tip from a passing BMW.
A bawab now and then brings his plastic chair, dozes through a few scenes (waking when something passes), then leaves.
The timer starts by itself when a clue opens (Act It Out, Who's the Impostor? and One Word Clues still wait for Start).
Finish the Lyric: Arabic Edition moved to Egypt & Arab World.
Finish the Lyric: a Despacito clue (four missing words).
Finish the Lyric and Finish the Lyric: Arabic Edition: 50 new clues each, 100 in both.
New category: Finish the Lyric: Arabic Edition. Finish the Lyric is now English and international songs only.
The NSFW code box no longer kicks you out of full screen.
The woman on the phone no longer waves her free hand about; it just holds the lead.
The woman with the dog takes her call a third of the way across and hangs up just before she walks off.
The woman walking her dog now wears jeans and a top.
New street scene: a woman chatting on her phone while walking her dog, who stops to sniff along the way.
Microbus from the left: the door faces you again, and the passenger now walks up in front and gets in through it.
Microbus: the door shows when it drives right to left; coming from the left the passenger gets in round the far side.
The cat walks past the smoking man before she breaks into a run.
Steals now work on the photo rounds and on Put It in Order (the phone shows the order list).
Price Is Right and Closest Wins no longer give hints like a price range under the answer box; the note only shows with the answer.
Era dates taken back out of the version history.
Version history shows roughly when each era happened.
No more phone answers toggle: a game with Closest Wins or Price Is Right shows the join code at the start, says what the phones are for, and has a Skip button.
NSFW: 25 more stars, 92 photos in all (18–19 per value).
The street scene now pauses while a clue is open and carries on from the same moment when you close it.
Tuk-tuk: only the front wheel and its mudguard moved forward; the nose and headlamp are back as they were.
The tuk-tuk's front wheel sits further forward under its nose.
The tuk-tuk is rounder, like the real ones: curved back, bulbous nose, rounded windscreen and roof.
The tuk-tuk's windscreen is raked back more.
The tuk-tuk's windscreen is now one big pane with just a yellow frame, like the real ones.
The microbus door is on its right side, just behind the front seats, like in Egypt; going the other way you see the doorless side and the passenger gets in round the far side.
Street scene order: microbus, ful cart, cat, tuk-tuk, hantour.
In the cat scene, a man walks the other way smoking a cigarette, taking a drag now and then and breathing out smoke.
The street scene now hides while a clue is open (it keeps going behind it).
The tuk-tuk is back in the street scene, now a proper Egyptian Bajaj: yellow front, navy body, black canvas roof.
The street scene now plays one scene at a time: microbus, ful cart, cat, hantour. Each comes from the other side the next time round.
The café and tuk-tuk are gone; the cat walks in then runs; no pompom on the horse.
Football mode: the chest hold is more natural. Two chest touches with a step in between, a 0.6 s hold, then a torso flick to the foot and an instant volley.
The street scene is redrawn to look real: a proper ahwa with a lit shopfront, people in galabeyas and emmas, a Bajaj tuk-tuk, a white microbus, a copper ful qidra and a ginger cat.
No speech bubbles; the shisha smoker now blows a big cloud every other time; the microbus passenger walks in and waits for it.
The street scene's horses are now a proper hantour: a horse pulling an Egyptian carriage, driver up front with his whip.
New setup toggle under Sound: Board animations, to switch the street scene and the Football kickers off.
Football mode: a new kicker move. He takes it on his chest, holds it there with his arms out, lets it drop and volleys it back. Arms now come out for balance on every chest control.
A little Cairo street now plays under the board in normal mode: a shisha café with two men playing tawla, plus a tuk-tuk, a packed microbus, a horse caravan, a ful cart and a stray cat passing by.
New locked category: NSFW (end of Party Games). Tap it and enter the code to add it. Name the adult film star from the photo.
New category: Blockbusters (Entertainment). Big-film trivia from Titanic to Oppenheimer, with Box Office Battles mixed in: three films, which made the most?
Version history: the 4.x versions are now one short line each, like the older ones.
Football mode phone page: the question is in navy, matching the buttons.
In Football mode the phone page says Joga Bonito, like the TV.
In Football mode, the phone page players use turns green to match the TV.
Football mode: a new stick-figure move. He catches the ball on his raised foot, holds it there for a second and a half, then flicks it up and volleys it.
The heel pass looks more real: he bends right over and kicks his heel up high behind him, and the ball sails over his back.
Football mode: a new stick-figure move. Knee control, a flick over his own head, then he bends forward and heels it back over himself to the other player.
Football mode: getting up after a bicycle kick, the stick figure pushes off the floor with both hands behind his feet.
Football mode: getting up after a bicycle kick, the stick figure pushes off the floor with his hand.
Football mode: after a bicycle kick the stick figure gets up like a person: sits up, tucks his feet under into a crouch, then stands.
Football mode: the header that sends the ball across now has a big, powerful wind-up.
Football mode: the stick figures wind up their headers (head back, then snap forward), and after a bicycle kick they land on the ground and get back up.
Football mode: the stick figures keep playing, faintly, behind an open clue.
Football mode: the stick figures can now chest it, flick it up with their foot, and send it back with a bicycle kick.
Football mode: another stick-figure move. They knee the ball up high, over their head, then jump and head it straight back.
Fix: Football mode with Free-for-all on no longer asks you to pick a category first.
Football mode: the two chest controls are spread out in the stick figures' routine instead of back to back.
Football mode: the stick figures have a new move. They lean back, control the ball on their chest so it pops up, then volley it across.
Setup: the Free-for-all switch now sits with the other game options, next to Steals from phones.
Setup: the Photo rounds section is gone. Every photo is built in.
The join code at the start only shows when phones will be used: Steals from phones on, or phone answers on with Closest Wins or Price Is Right on the board.
"The Hunger Games" category is now just "Hunger Games".
Setup: "Answer QR codes" is now "Phone answers for Closest Wins and Price Is Right", and "Steal QR codes" is now "Steals from phones" (there's only one join code now).
Egypt: Photo Edition has all 100 photos.

Team games: each team's phones scan one code at the start (or later from Join code at the top). After that, Closest Wins and Price Is Right number boxes and steal boxes pop up on them. No more code on every clue.
On the phones, an answer is hidden once it's sent and can't be changed. Free-for-all switches off and greys out Power-ups, Answer and Steal codes, and the team-only categories.

New: Free-for-all (bottom of setup). No teams: everyone scans one code at the start and plays on their own phone. Every clue's answer box pops up by itself, everyone who's right scores, and the host just confirms the ticks.
Works on the Cloudflare link. Act It Out, One Word Clues and Who's the Impostor are left out of it.
Football mode: the slogan collage shows through the board again (5.23 had made the tiles solid green by mistake).
Guess the Country gets its Qatar photo and Cairo Streets & Places its 6th October Bridge photo.

New: Guess the Country (Photo Rounds), 100 photos from the Eiffel Tower to Liechtenstein's Vaduz Castle, and Egypt: Photo Edition (after Egypt), 100 photos from all over Egypt with a different question on each.
Cairo Streets & Places gets 8 more photo clues. Steal codes work on all of them.
When a team has ×2 ready, the board shows every value doubled (200 to 1000) until the tile is played.
New in Party Games: Put It in Order. Three events (films, football, tech, Egypt, the news); drag them into order, earliest first. The reveal shows the dates.
Steal QR codes now also show on Guess the Food; only the zoom and blur photo rounds (Car, Actor, Footballer, Person, Logo) go without.
Egypt History and Cairo Streets & Places now have photo clues: 10 each, from Nasser and the 1973 crossing to Baron Palace and Bab Zuweila.
One Word Clues, Act It Out and Impostor: the notes under the QR code are centred again.
QR codes on clues are less dense, so phones can scan them from further away.
QR codes on clues are centred and a bit smaller, with "Scan to steal" underneath and the stealing teams listed to the right.
The phone-answer and steal codes no longer have an outline box around them.
A team that sends a steal now shows as just "Team ✓" on every clue.
After the reveal, steals show simply as "Team: answer".
Steal codes just say "Scan to steal", and a team's name pops up on screen the moment it sends a steal.
On photo clues the steal code sits beside the picture, so the buttons stay in view.
Steal QR codes skip the A/B/C rounds (Most Spotify Listeners, Most Instagram Followers, Most Calories, Real Headline) and the photo rounds.
Phone answers: each team's box now just shows Waiting… or Locked in ✓ (tap Type to enter a number for a team).
The answer reveals by itself once every team has sent its number.
Closest Wins and Price Is Right show a QR code: each team scans it and sends its number from a phone, hidden until the reveal.
New setup switch, Steal QR codes: teams that aren't playing can scan and send a steal, worth half the points.
Resume game: if the page is refreshed or closed mid-game, the title screen offers to pick up where you left off, with the same scores, turn and board.
New category: Netflix Hits (100 clues), from Money Heist and Squid Game to Wednesday, Dark and Paranormal.
Status: the sounds now download as soon as you open it, and show 5 / 5 on every browser, Safari included.
Guess the Food and Stadium photos are about a third of their old size, so they load about three times faster.
New Status section in setup: see how many photos of each photo round are downloaded, whether fonts, the world map, QR codes and sounds are ready, and download everything before guests arrive.
Fixed photos that could take ages (or seem never to appear) on a slow connection: the photo on screen now always comes first, and other photos download quietly in the background.
Photos appear much faster: every tile's photo starts downloading as soon as the board is shown, so it's usually ready before you open it.
Guess the Food loads one photo at a time instead of big bundles.
Faster start: the game no longer waits for Google Fonts before showing anything. Text may show in a plain font for a moment.
The game opens much faster on a slow connection: it no longer waits for the map, QR code and photo-export tools before showing the title screen.
Football mode: the scoring buttons under each answer are now solid navy, with the +100 in green.

era: 4.x: The Big Check, Football Mode & New Rounds

items: More clues for Finish the Lyric, Rom-Coms, The Hunger Games, Islam, both Which Country? rounds, Formations and Guess the Food: every category now has at least 100.
20 new food photos, from pizza and mango to breadfruit and salak.
The screen-mirroring note on setup now matches the colour of the line above it.
The setup screen now says how the game is best played: screen mirroring a laptop to the TV.
Buttons now light up and lift slightly when you hover over them, like the clue tiles on the board.
Fixed: the "After review" sound now plays every time you open Edit scores, not just the first time.
More clues for Egyptian Memes, Ramadan Series, Real Headline, Shirt Numbers, Managers, Video Games, Pixar & DreamWorks and Currencies: each now has 100 (20 per tile value).
"The Price Is Right" is now just "Price Is Right".
New category: Currencies.
The Price Is Right doubled to 100 clues: more groceries, fuel, Netflix and Spotify in Egypt, console launch prices and record transfers.

New category: The Price Is Right. Both teams guess a price and the closest wins: everyday Egyptian prices like eggs, fruit, Pepsi, Nutella and koshary (then and now), plus bread, the Metro, petrol, the dollar and famous world prices.
All sounds are 20% quieter, and the timer's end chime is 30% quieter.
Normal mode: tapping Edit scores plays a quick "After review…".
Fixed: ending a game sometimes skipped the intro clip and went straight to the Siuuu.
Normal mode's winner screen also plays "Referee, no fair" before the Siuuu.
Winner screen: smoother hand-over from the intro clip into the Siuuu. Normal mode plays only the Siuuu again.
Winner screen: before the Siuuu, you now hear Messi's "¿Qué mirás, bobo?" or "Referee, no fair", taking turns each game.
Football mode: tapping Edit scores plays the "After review… number 10 Paraguay" VAR call.
2 new categories: Which Country? (name the country a city is in) and Which Country? Arab Edition (cities across the Arab world).
Setup screen: Act It Out: Egypt Edition is back in Party Games, and the Egypt group is reordered.
Football mode: Shirt Numbers and Managers can now come up on the board.
Setup screen: every Egypt category is now in the Egypt & Arab World group.
7 new categories: Ramadan Series, Egyptian Memes, Shirt Numbers, Managers, Video Games, Pixar & DreamWorks, and Real Headline (three headlines, only one is true).
Football mode background: added "NO FAIR" and "ظالم ظلم".
Football mode stick figures: new heel flick. They turn their back, pop the ball up with the heel, turn round and volley it. Each player now does knee, foot, head and heel.
Football mode background: new "BAR-CO-LA" block, each part in a different font.
Football mode stick figures: a full rotation of knee, foot and header touches, each popped up and volleyed across. The ball spins less.
Football mode background: "GOAL!" is now "Calma", and "It's a fucking disgrace" is spelled out in full.
Football mode: the phrases behind the board are now big and small, wide and tall blocks, like a retro poster, instead of an even grid.
Football mode: the stick figures show some skill now. One kills the ball on his knee and volleys it across; the other cushions it on his foot, flicks it up and volleys it back.
Football mode: the stick figures now pass the ball slowly, 8 seconds per crossing.
Football mode: two little stick figures pass the ball back and forth above the team names while you pick a clue.
Rom-Coms now sits right after Disney/CN/Nickelodeon on the setup screen.
New category: Finish the Lyric. Half the songs are Arabic.
Shorter category names: Disney/CN/Nickelodeon, HIMYM, Movie & TV Quotes and Movie & TV Quotes: Egypt Edition.
Two new Entertainment categories: Rom-Coms and The Hunger Games, 80 clues each.
Football mode is now titled Joga Bonito, in a retro shop-sign font.
The Football mode board is now titled Joga Night.
The Siuuu clip now plays on the winner screen in normal mode too, at half its old volume.
The version history now needs a code to open.
Football mode: the half-points button is plain yellow text instead of a navy box.
108 blurry photo-round pictures swapped for sharp ones, like Thierry Henry in Guess the Footballer.
In Instagram, Spotify and Most Calories, the right answer shows big and bold, with the other figures smaller underneath.
The countdown ticks, the time's-up chime and the winner sounds are about 4 times louder, so you can hear them over the room.
Football mode's Siuuu clip is louder too, and the game unlocks sound on your first tap so browsers can't silently block it.
Football Transfers is now just called Transfers.
Football mode's match ball always sits right next to the Jeopardy Night title, never on the line below.
119 new photos in Guess the Car, Actor, Footballer and Person, so every value in those rounds has about the same number of photos.
Most Calories has 30 new foods and drinks, from Starbucks Frappuccinos to a McDonald's Big Breakfast, and 30 new trios.
New category in Knowledge: Islam, with 80 clues on the Quran, the pillars, Ramadan and Hajj, the Prophet's life and early Islamic history.
30 more clues in almost every category: about 2,200 new ones, six at each value.
Guess the Logo has 30 new logos, including PSG, Man City, Inter, Dortmund, Galatasaray, Al Hilal, Smouha and Juhayna.
Tapping the version number now just shows the version history.
Football mode's title shows a classic match ball instead of ⚽, a different one each board: Total 90 Aerow, Jabulani, Ordem 3, Seitiro or Teamgeist.
The winner screen's LED strip enters from the right with SSSIIIIIIII, then the U's never end. It also moves half as fast again.
Football mode celebrates the winner with fireworks instead of confetti.
The winner screen's LED strip scrolls half as fast and now reads SSSSSSIIIIIIIIUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUU.
Football mode's winner screen has a scrolling stadium LED strip: SIIIIIIIUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUU.
The Football mode collage fits the board exactly: no phrase is cut off or repeated.
New phrases: نادي القرن, الفراعنة, Hand of God, If I speak I am in big trouble, Good ebening, Cold rainy night in Stoke, Fergie time, Tiki-taka and What do we think of shit?
The Football mode collage starts under the category names, which sit on solid green again.
The Football mode collage behind the board is much easier to see.
The Football mode collage sits just behind the board and is easier to see.
The Football mode collage now shows through the board too.
Football mode has a faint retro poster collage of football phrases behind the board: SIIIIIUUUUUU, AGÜEROOOOO, Ankara Messi, الكورة أجوان and more.
Football mode board values are white.
Guess the Logo starts a little less blurred, and Less blur clears it in smaller steps.
30 more logos in Guess the Logo (110 in all), including Ismaily, e&, Al Jazeera, MBC, Arsenal and Bayern.
Tap the version number on the title screen to see what's new and the full version history.
7 new categories: Egyptian Proverbs, How I Met Your Mother, Guess the Score, Space & Planets, Most Spotify Listeners, Most Instagram Followers and Guess the Logo.
Guess the Logo shows a blurred logo. The host can tap Less blur if nobody gets it.
